parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualitySignalTests.swift` within the `Wallpaper` package. The two methods — `QualitySignalTests.recoveryMagnitudeResets` (line 258) and `QualitySignalTests.recoveryMagnitudeSeed` (line 272) — are distinct test cases that, despite a Jaccard similarity of ~0.71, are intentionally exercising different behavioural aspects of the `QualitySignal` type (reset behaviour vs. seed behaviour). Collapsing or extracting them would obscure test intent and reduce diagnostic clarity when either assertion fails. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters are classified as intentional duplication.
